prompts.starter-cabin.webp:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent sprite for the Dyson Christmas snowglobe website. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; match its muted navy blue, ivory snow, champagne-gold touches, quiet Nordic illustration, light fine-grain texture and very shallow dimensional thickness. The new object is a humble starter scene prop, much simpler and less decorated than the reference. Real transparent background, full isolated object centered with generous transparent margin, no text, no framing, no cast ground shadow, no other props, no stars, no baubles, no botanical surface patterns, no confetti, no loose dots. Matte illustration rather than glossy toy 3D, very gentle shading.
Subject: a tiny cozy Christmas cabin, straight-on front view, a simple navy triangular roof with soft ivory snow cap, ivory walls, one small warm amber square window, a plain navy door, a short chimney. Low compact silhouette, clean readable shapes. No wreath, no trees, no decorations or signage.
